title: Use the Billing vs Collections report
summary: Compares what was invoiced with what was actually collected in the period.
keywords: how much of what was invoiced was collected

steps.title: Menu → Reports → Billing vs Collections
steps.details: Compares what was invoiced with what was actually collected in the period.

steps.title: Period
steps.details: Today, this week, this month, last month, this year or your own range.

steps.title: Currency
steps.details: Shows the amounts in the chosen currency.

steps.title: Currency
steps.details: Only if the clinic works with two currencies: all or one.

steps.title: Generate
steps.details: Calculates the report with the chosen filters.

steps.title: No data
steps.details: There's no data for those filters: try another period.

steps.title: Indicators
steps.details: Percentage collected of what was invoiced.

steps.title: Results
steps.details: Invoiced vs. collected per period, and what's pending.

steps.title: Details
steps.details: Sort by column by tapping the header.

steps.title: Export
steps.details: Excel, CSV or PDF with what you're viewing.
